name: Weird Therapy
source:
So there's something wrong with you, right? Something you just can't explain.

That's where Weird Therapy can help!

Our highly reccommended clinical psychologist Dr. Alice Limin will take you through our trusty TEN STEP QUESTIONNAIRE, and find the answers you've been seeking!

Need some fresh air? Take a walk through our cosy minimalist corridors. Let the emptiness soak in. I can't wait to meet you.

Book Today!

[From [url=https://swampsnail.itch.io/weird-therapy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那你有什么问题吧？有一些你无法解释的事情。

这就是奇怪疗法可以提供帮助的地方！

我们高度推荐的临床心理学家Alice Limin博士将带你完成我们值得信赖的十步问卷，并找到你一直在寻找的答案！

需要一些新鲜空气吗？漫步穿过我们舒适的简约走廊。让空虚感渗透进来。我迫不及待地想见到你。

立即预订！
